//: Shared Zed setup for this template. The canonical build is the Makefile, exposed as tasks in .zed/tasks.json; texlab additionally does a fast incremental build on save so that forward search has an up-to-date PDF to jump into.

texlab.//forwardSearch: Skim on macOS. Adjust the path for a non-default install, or swap in zathura, sioyek, okular or evince. Inverse search (PDF back to editor) is not auto-configured for Skim and needs a one-time manual setting inside Skim itself.
texlab.//chktex: Off on purpose: this project has its own checks in make lint, and chktex would add a second, conflicting opinion.

//languages: Sources use one sentence per line, so lines are long by design. Soft wrapping keeps them readable without ever reflowing the file.
